faq.intro: A few of the things guests ask most. Can't find your answer? Our team is a message away.

items.q: What's included in the fare?
items.a: Explora journeys are generously inclusive: your ocean-front suite, dining across the ship's restaurants, premium drinks and speciality coffees, Wi-Fi, in-suite dining and onboard gratuities are included as standard.

items.q: How do I reserve a journey?
items.a: Find a sailing that suits you, choose your suite, and send a request. A specialist confirms availability and the final price with you before anything is finalised.

items.q: Is a deposit required?
items.a: A deposit can secure your suite while the booking is confirmed; the balance is due closer to departure. Your specialist will explain the exact terms for your sailing.

items.q: Can I travel solo?
items.a: Yes. Selected sailings offer solo fares and reduced single supplements — ask us and we'll find the best option for a journey on your own.

items.q: What are the suites like?
items.a: Every suite is ocean-front with floor-to-ceiling windows and a private terrace, from Ocean Terrace Suites to the Owner's Residences. Each tier adds more space and more amenities.

items.q: How do I get help planning?
items.a: Send us a message with your dates, destinations and number of guests. We'll come back to you personally — no call centres, no chatbots.

about.title: Your specialist for ultra-luxury journeys at sea
about.lede: We help discerning travellers discover Explora Journeys — an all-suite, ultra-luxury way to see the world by ocean.
body: As an authorised partner, we bring you the full Explora fleet, every itinerary and every suite — with the personal care of a specialist team that knows these ships inside out.
From a first idea to the moment you step aboard, you have one point of contact: a real person who plans around what matters to you, answers honestly, and stays with you through the journey.
We believe luxury travel should feel effortless. Our job is to make the planning quiet, the choices clear, and the journey unforgettable.

items.q: When can I register for an account and see my booking?
a: You can create an account with us even before you make a booking. Once you have booked, you'll be able to access your booking through your account.

items.q: How do I make a booking?
a: You can book directly through our website, or get in touch with us and one of our team will be happy to assist you. You may also book through your preferred travel advisor.

items.q: How do I reserve suites for a group?
a: To reserve more than five suites for a group, please contact us and let us know whether the booking is for a promotional group, a corporate or incentive event, or a family and friends gathering.

items.q: Can I deal with the same person throughout the booking process?
a: Yes. Any of our team can assist you with your booking, but if you'd like to work with the same person throughout, simply ask for their name so you can reach them again.

items.q: May I transfer my booking to my travel agent?
a: Reservations may be transferred to the travel advisor of your choice prior to final payment. We recommend speaking with your travel advisor before requesting a transfer, and we'll need their contact details to complete it. Please note this is offered on a one-time basis, and reservations made within the final-payment window or already paid in full cannot be transferred.

items.q: The journey is sold out. Can I join a wait list?
a: Yes. We clear wait lists as suites become available.

items.q: Do I need to register my details (passport, photos) before embarkation?
a: You'll be asked to provide these details during the booking process and again during check-in.

items.q: Is there a special rate for children?
a: Infants aged 6 to 23 months sail with our compliments, while children aged 2 to 17 enjoy savings of up to 50%. For comfort and safety, infants must be at least 6 months old at the time of sailing.

items.q: I made a mistake on my online booking. What should I do?
a: Please get in touch with us and our team will help you correct it.

items.q: What happens if I cancel my journey?
a: Cancellation terms are set out in our Terms & Conditions. Please review them, or contact us and we'll be glad to explain how they apply to your booking.

items.q: I can no longer travel. Could someone take my place?
a: This is possible, provided your replacement meets all the conditions for the transfer and written notice is given no later than 14 days before the journey start date.

items.q: How can I get a suite upgrade?
a: Contact us for a quotation on an upgrade, subject to availability. On eligible journeys you can also bid for an upgraded suite through our Suite Upgrade programme: you may bid on more than one suite to increase your chances, with the assurance that only one will ever be charged. If your bid is successful you'll receive confirmation and the steps to finalise payment; if not, there is no additional charge and you keep your originally booked suite.

items.q: Do you offer hotels, transfers and destination experiences?
a: Yes. We offer a range of pre- and post-journey options, including hotels, transfers and destination experiences. Contact us to arrange them.

items.q: Can I arrange flights too?
a: Yes. We offer both commercial and private air options, including bundled packages with transfers and hotel stays. Get in touch and we'll help you arrange them.

items.q: What payment methods are accepted?
a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club and UnionPay. Digital payment options such as PayPal, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay and Google Pay are also supported.

items.q: Can I hold a booking without paying immediately?
a: Yes. You can place an optional booking which is held for 7 days. If no payment is made within this period, the booking is automatically cancelled.

items.q: How much is the deposit and when is it due?
a: A 25% deposit of the journey fare is required to confirm your booking. The payment deadline depends on how far in advance you book:
121 or more days before departure: deposit due within 7 days.
120 to 31 days before departure: deposit due within 3 days.
30 days or fewer before departure: deposit due within 1 day.

items.q: When will my card be charged?
a: If you choose to pay by card, your card is charged immediately upon payment.

items.q: What is included in the fare?
a: The journey fare includes suite accommodation, all meals onboard, alcoholic and soft drinks, cocktails, mineral water, gratuities, port charges, WiFi, entertainment, and complimentary transfers from the port to the town centre where applicable. Depending on the suite category or promotional fare booked, additional benefits may apply.

The fare does not include medical expenses, independent contractors' services or products, or destination experiences. Some food and beverage experiences are available for an additional fee. Additional inclusions apply for Penthouse and Residence suites.

items.q: What is the pricing on Extended or Grand Journeys?
a: Extended and Grand Journeys let you discover more by combining multiple journeys or through longer sailings. Combining sailings into an Extended Journey can save up to 5% compared with booking them individually, while our longer, immersive Grand Journeys can save up to 10%. Contact us for details.

items.q: Are the rates shown per person or per suite?
a: During the online booking process, the journey fare is shown per person. Contact us if you'd like further information on suite fares.

items.q: Are there savings if I book in advance?
a: If you book at least one year in advance, you may benefit from our Early Booking Benefit, offering a 5% discount depending on when itineraries are released.

items.q: Can I get a lower price if I book direct?
a: Our journey fares offer the same exceptional value whether you book through a travel advisor, online, or directly with us.

items.q: If the fare drops after I book, will I get the lower price?
a: We do not follow a discounting strategy. However, if your fare is reduced for any reason after booking, please contact us and we'll review the situation and discuss the options available to you.

items.q: Are your journeys suitable for solo travellers?
a: Yes. Our journeys are well suited to solo travellers, and on selected journeys we offer a 0% solo supplement. Otherwise a single supplement usually applies for sole occupancy of a suite, with the amount varying by journey and suite category. Contact us for specific availability.

items.q: Can I bring my whole family?
a: We'd be delighted to welcome your family onboard. We offer a selection of interconnecting suites to accommodate families comfortably. Most suites and residences have a maximum occupancy of four guests, though this can vary by category, so it's important to confirm availability and suitability at the time of booking. Contact us and we'll help you find the best options.

items.q: When do I receive my tickets and documentation?
a: After you finalise your booking and pay the deposit, you'll receive a booking confirmation by email. If any changes or additional payments are made, an updated confirmation is sent. Your e-ticket is issued once check-in is completed, and check-in opens 90 days before departure.

items.q: Where can I find the day-to-day itinerary?
a: You'll find a detailed overview of your journey within your booking confirmation.

items.q: What documents do I need on embarkation day?
a: On embarkation day you'll need your reservation confirmation or e-ticket, your passport, a credit card, and a visa if applicable.

items.q: My passport hasn't arrived yet. Can I still check in?
a: Valid documentation is mandatory prior to embarkation. Guests without a valid passport will be denied boarding.

items.q: Is any special documentation required for pregnant guests?
a: We cannot accommodate guests who will be more than 23 weeks and 6 days pregnant at any point during the journey. Guests who are less than 23 weeks and 6 days pregnant throughout the journey must provide a letter from their obstetrician confirming the expected due date, that the pregnancy is low-risk, and that they are fit to travel without immediate access to specialised obstetric or neonatal care.

If you have already booked and do not meet this requirement, please contact us. We reserve the right to refuse boarding to any guest who appears to be in an advanced state of pregnancy or who does not provide the required medical certificate.

items.q: What is your policy on passports and visas?
a: Passport, visa and health requirements vary by destination and are subject to change. It is the responsibility of each guest, or their travel advisor, to ensure all necessary and valid travel documents are obtained for the journey, including compliance with immigration and health regulations at each port of call. Where an itinerary requires it, please ensure you carry multi-entry visas. Guests without proper documentation will be denied boarding and no refund will be issued.
Please note that passports must be valid for at least six months beyond the completion date of the journey.

items.q: Do I need travel insurance?
a: We strongly recommend that all guests obtain comprehensive travel insurance from the time of booking through to the completion of the journey, including cover for cancellation, medical assistance and expenses, and loss of or damage to luggage.

items.q: What is the onboard currency?
a: The onboard currency varies according to the itinerary.

The following itineraries operate in Euro: Mediterranean & Western Europe; Northern Europe; Iceland & Greenland; Red Sea & Arabian Peninsula; and Grand Journeys between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea & Arabian Peninsula.

The following itineraries operate in US Dollars: Caribbean & Central America; Alaska; South America & Amazon; Central & North America Pacific Coast; US & Canada East Coast & New England; and Transatlantic Grand Journeys.

items.q: Can I use a different card onboard?
a: Yes. Our hosts will be happy to assist you at Guest Services.
